watches.name: Maestro GC Sport Tennis
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 100 PIECES A color never before seen in the Maestro GC Sport collection: Light Turquoise. Vibrant yet refined, bold yet elegant, this distinctive shade brings fresh energy to one of the Maison’s most recognizable creations. The dial reveals a delicate gradient effect enhanced by a unique granular texture, creating a captivating interplay of depth and light that changes continuously with every movement of the wrist. Dynamic and expressive, the Light Turquoise dial transforms the watch into a true statement piece while preserving the understated sophistication that defines Gerald Charles

watches.name: Masterlink Atelier Edition Golden Rose
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 25 PIECES Each dial is individually hand-hammered by one of Gerald Charles' experienced artisans at the Maison's Atelier in Geneva. This is not a mechanised or semi-automated process. It is a traditional Métier d'Art - a craft requiring long experience , calibrated force, and an intimate knowledge of how metal responds to repeated impact. The Masterlink is defined by engineered precision : controlled geometries, invisible construction, mechanised perfection . The hand-hammered dial introduces something purposefully different - the visible, unrepeatable mark of a human being working with traditional tools.

watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 10 PIECES Gérald Charles Genta was famous for his appetite for experimentation, and few materials captured that spirit better than natural stone: unpredictable, alive with colour , and impossible to fully control. The Masterlink Stone Dial continues that tradition, pairing the founder's love of the unexpected with the technical precision of the modern Maison. PRICE ON DEMAND

watches.name: Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin Asia Edition
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 80 PIECES A unique timepiece dedicated exclusively to Asia : a bold, vibrant and technically challenging limited edition built around one of this market's most culturally significant materials: jade . Limited to only 80 pieces, this special creation combines Gerald Charles’ unmistakable design language with one of the most difficult natural stones to shape into the iconic Maestro silhouette.

watches.name: Maestro GC Sport Tennis
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 250 PIECES The Maestro GC Sport Tennis White reinterprets high-performance watchmaking through the lens of tennis tradition, where purity, precision, and elegance define every detail. Crafted in hardened Darkblast ® titanium and engineered with ErgonTeq ® ergonomics, it delivers exceptional comfort, durability, and refined sporting functionality. A seamless fusion of technical mastery and timeless style, designed to perform effortlessly from Centre Court to everyday sophistication.

watches.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph
watches.description: The Maestro 3.0 Chronograph Clay captures the spirit of red clay courts through a richly textured fumé dial, blending sporting inspiration with refined design. Crafted in stainless steel and engineered with Ergonteq ® ergonomics, it ensures durability, comfort, and precision in every condition. A bold expression of chronograph mastery, uniting technical performance with the unmistakable elegance of Gerald Charles.

watches.name: Mini Maestro Silver
watches.description: The Mini Maestro Silver embodies timeless elegance through a refined interplay of light, texture, and diamond-set brilliance. Crafted in lightweight titanium with ErgonTeq® comfort, it offers effortless wear and a graceful, jewelry-like presence. An intimate expression of Gerald Charles’ legacy, designed to elevate every moment from day to evening.

watches.name: Mini Maestro Ice Blue
watches.description: The Mini Maestro Ice Blue captures a fresh, luminous spirit, where delicate tones meet refined watchmaking artistry. Enhanced by a Clous de Paris dial and diamond-set bezel, it balances modern femininity with everyday versatility. A poetic creation that transforms with every occasion, blending technical precision with expressive elegance.

watches.name: Mini Maestro Pink
watches.description: The Mini Maestro Pink reveals a soft yet confident aesthetic, celebrating beauty through subtle color and radiant detail. Its diamond accents and sculpted titanium case create a harmonious balance between sophistication and comfort. A versatile statement of style, designed to move effortlessly with the rhythm of modern life.

watches.name: Masterlink Perpetual Calendar Fumé dial
watches.description: The Masterlink Perpetual Calendar with fumé dial unveils a sculptural vision of time, where depth, symmetry, and legibility redefine a grand complication. Powered by the in-house asymmetrical calibre with micro-rotor, it delivers over a century of precision within an ultra-thin, ergonomic titanium case. A bold fusion of architectural design and technical mastery, embodying the pure “No Compromise” spirit of Gerald Charles.

watches.name: Masterlink Perpetual Calendar Sapphire Dial
watches.description: The Masterlink Perpetual Calendar with sapphire dial reveals the full poetry of its movement, offering a captivating open-worked view of its mechanical architecture. Engineered entirely in-house, its groundbreaking asymmetrical perpetual calendar combines innovation, precision, and exceptional readability. A transparent expression of haute horlogerie, where design, engineering, and craftsmanship exist in perfect harmony.

watches.name: Masterlink Boutique Edition
watches.description: The Masterlink Boutique Edition is conceived as a limited edition available exclusively through Gerald Charles boutiques. This bold evolution of Gerald Charles’ first asymmetrical integrated bracelet, is crafted in Darkblast® stainless steel. The black double-layer sunray dial creates remarkable depth and light interplay, enhancing the watch’s dynamic geometry. Beneath its ultra-slim profile beats the i n-house development caliber, Ref. GCA1000: a testament to precision engineering and discreet mechanical sophistication. Designed with ErgonTeq® for uncompromising comfort, the Masterlink Boutique Edition delivers a seamless fit.

watches.name: Maestro 2.0 Meteorite Silver
watches.description: The Maestro 2.0 Meteorite, the Maison’s first meteorite timepiece to feature a small-seconds indicator, is a 100-piece limited edition crafted in a polished stainless-steel case, powered by the ultra-thin Swiss Manufacture automatic Calibre GCA2011 and water-resistant to 100 metres, distinguished by its striking two-level Muonionalusta meteorite dial that brings a truly cosmic character to the watch.

watches.name: Maestro 2.0 Meteorite Darkblast®
watches.description: The Maestro 2.0 Meteorite, the Maison’s first meteorite timepiece to feature a small-seconds indicator, is a 100-piece limited edition crafted in a Darkblast® stainless-steel case, powered by the ultra-thin Swiss Manufacture automatic Calibre GCA2011 and water-resistant to 100 metres, distinguished by its striking two-level Muonionalusta meteorite dial that brings a truly cosmic character to the watch.

watches.name: Masterlink Gem-Set
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 10 PIECES An expression of modern luxury, this Masterlink is adorned with 60 baguette-cut red sapphires. The gemstones’ warmth enhances the sculptural architecture of the watch, creating a statement of creativity and individuality. Limited to just 10 pieces, it is as rare as it is radiant. PRICE ON DEMAND

watches.name: Masterlink Gem-Set
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 10 PIECES A dazzling tribute to Gerald Charles’ legacy, this edition showcases a white gold bezel set with 60 custom-cut blue baguette sapphires. Their deep, vivid hue contrasts against the silver double-layered dial, distinguished by vertical stripes and enriched with 13 blue sapphire indexes. PRICE ON DEMAND

watches.name: Masterlink Gem-Set
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 10 PIECES This rare interpretation of the Masterlink highlights a bezel adorned with 60 baguette-cut tsavorites of the purest intensity. The vivid green glow harmonises with the asymmetrical Maestro case, showcasing craftsmanship and originality. Produced in only 10 examples, it captures nature’s brilliance in a jewel of horology. PRICE ON DEMAND

watches.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph
watches.description: The Maestro 3.0 Chronograph grey dial adds a contemporary edge to the classic baroque-inspired Maestro case. The Darkblast ® Grade 5 Titanium case and screw-down crown deliver 100 meters of water resistance, and shockproof durability making it as reliable as it is refined.

watches.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph
watches.description: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph sunburst ice blue dial paired with the Clous de Paris strap creates an extraordinary sense of depth, while the signature mini tapisserie pattern offers seamless harmony between dial and strap. With its polished stainless steel case and enhanced ergonomic comfort through ErgonTeq ® technology, this timepiece is built for both sophistication and performance.

watches.name: Maestro GC Sport Tennis
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 200 PIECES The GC Sport Tennis features a Darkblast ® titanium case and a grainy-textured yellow dial with applied Arabic numerals at 3, 9, and 12. Inspired by modern tennis aesthetics, its ultralight Velcro strap, crafted in-house in Geneva, mirrors the dial’s porous effect. Tested and approved by professional players, it boasts 5G shock resistance, weighs only 64 grams, and features a left-hand crown to prevent rubbing during matches. The ErgonTeq ® design ensures the lugs, case, and strap sit ergonomically, adapting to all wrist sizes for maximum stability and weight distribution. Engineered for performance and versatility, this timepiece embodies Gerald Charles’ commitment to innovation and comfort.

watches.name: Maestro GC39 25th Anniversary Edition
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 100 PIECES The Maestro GC39 25th Anniversary Edition reimagines the iconic 2005 Maestro GC39 by Mr. Genta. The watch features the rare jumping hours complication, a superb manufacture movement crafted in-house, and a lapis lazuli dial brought to life through Meta Guillochage, a pioneering micro-chemical engraving technique.

watches.name: Maestro 9.0 Roman Tourbillon
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 50 PIECES The Maestro 9.0 Roman Tourbillon celebrates the Roman architecture and art from which the iconic Maestro case inspiration comes from; amply emphasised by the roman numerals on the dial.

watches.name: Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin Lapis Lazuli
watches.description: Introducing the Maestro 2.0 Lapis Lazuli: a tribute to Mr. Genta's favourite gemstone and the first Gerald Charles hardstone dial watch. The timepiece is complemented by the Maestro’s polished stainless-steel case and resistant blue-coated bezel, the Maison's new logo and the Clou de Paris rubber strap.

watches.name: Maestro 4.0 Ducati 30° Anniversario 916
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 250 PIECES The Maestro 4.0 Ducati 30° Anniversario 916 is a collaboration between Gerald Charles and Ducati, blending the precision of watchmaking with the fervour of motorcycling. Gerald Charles revives the iconic jumping hours, a complication Mr. Genta introduced with the Maestro GC39.

watches.name: Maestro 9.0 Roman Tourbillon
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 50 PIECES The Maestro 9.0 Roman Tourbillon celebrates the Roman architecture and art from which the iconic Maestro case inspiration comes from; amply emphasised by the roman numerals on the dial.

watches.name: Maestro 8.0 GC Sport Squelette
watches.description: The Maestro 8.0 GC Sport Squelette watch combines Mr. Genta's unmistakable Maestro case shape with an extraordinary open-worked movement. This skeleton watch truly celebrates the "art" of the mechanical timepiece and was created by contemporary and world-renowned watch designer Octavio Garcia. The case of the Maestro 8.0 GC Sport Squelette is based on the Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin model, and it has been slimmed down to 8.35mm, to enhance the watch's ergonomics further and push elegance and performance to their limits. The Maestro 8.0 GC Sport Squelette is water-resistant to 100 metres.

watches.name: Maestro 8.0 Squelette
watches.description: The Maestro 8.0 Squelette features a stoned grey vulcanized rubber strap, which perfectly matches the 18K Rose Gold 4N Maestro case, and sandblasted bridges polished with anglage and anthracite-NAC finishes. In order to ensure an higher legibility of the open-worked movement, the 4N Gold coloured and polished baton shaped hands are more squared and larger than in other watches of the Maestro Collection. Furthermore, the hands are filled with white Super-LumiNova, while the minute-track is in poudré Rose Gold 4N.

watches.name: Maestro 8.0 Squelette Gem-Set
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 10 PIECES The Maestro 8.0 Squelette Gem-Set Sapphires features 66 Yellow Sapphire stones 3.22 ct. of the highest purity, set by hand into an 18K white gold bezel by highly skilled artisans. The case is in medical grade stainless steel, while the Sunshine Yellow vulcanised rubber strap matches the colour of the precious gem. PRICE ON DEMAND

watches.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph

The matching vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.

watches.name: Maestro 2.0 Ultra-Thin Gem-Set
watches.description: The watch's timeless black sunburst dial and vulcanised rubber strap, featuring the Clous de Paris motif on the top side and GC's logo tapisserie on the other, fully match the stainless steel of the Maestro case and the polished pin buckle with brushed applied plate and GC logo engraved. Thanks to the sunburst finish, a play of lights is created: different layers of colour emerge, sometimes warmer, sometimes cooler, depending on the light it reflects. The precious gemstones on the bezel enhance the sunburst dial finish. PRICE ON DEMAND

watches.name: Masterlink Blue
watches.description: Keeping up with the asymmetry, the case and the bracelet of Masterlink are no less impressive. The Masterlink case still features the iconic “smile” at 6 o’clock yet changing on the top and becoming squarer. Therefore, the bracelet links echo the sinuous curve at the bottom while following the geometrical lines on the top. The juxtaposition of different curves and lines, however, contributes to the dynamic and harmonious balance of the watch aesthetics. The timepiece is available with a double-layered and sunburst dial featuring vertical stripes in blue colour. Masterlink, the future legacy: a timepiece that maintains Gerald Charles key values of legacy, versatility and craftsmanship, taking the Maison into the future.

watches.name: Maestro 3.0 Chronograph
watches.description: The Maestro 3.0 Chronograph is crafted in lightweight, mirror-polished Grade 5 titanium, a material that is as hard as steel, but 40 per cent lighter. The watch features a royal blue sunburst dial and the iconic indexes and peculiar hands shape, filled with Super-LumiNova, directly coming from Mr. Gérald Charles Genta's original drawings.

watches.name: Maestro 8.0 Squelette
watches.description: The Maestro 8.0 Squelette features some satin-finished and rhodium plated open-worked bridges, some others treated with anthracite NAC. All angles, bevels and apertures are diamond-cut and hand-polished, and the yellowgold wheels are decorated with circular graining, a traditional high-end watchmaking finish. The rehaut features white painted minute markers and hands filled with highly luminous Super-LumiNova. The rehaut is retained by a series of nine, star-shaped screws that were designed and developed specifically for Gerald Charles. The black vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.
